prompt: Fire wall block facing right: stamps his lead foot down and sweeps both flaming arms upward, and a tall wall of roaring orange and yellow fire erupts from the ground in front of him on the right side, rising taller than his head and flickering while he holds a crossed-arm defensive guard behind it, then the fire wall sinks down into glowing embers and he returns to his boxing guard. Feet stay planted.
